name: Sankaku Matsuri Vol.2
source:
Among other goodies fan disc includes three mini-stories:
1. "Sakura Kikou - Aftermath" 「サクラ紀行」～その後～
2. “Maya-sensei's daily life” 「麻耶せんせいの日常」
3. Mahou Senshi Princess Tear mini-scenario that did not get to the main game.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
